ID_PGRP_009.name: AK74 AGS-74 PRO Sniper Pistol Grip

notes: slots: membership is the Inventory.Slot.* tag in the ItemContext of each item definition (ID_*.json); the loadout screen names them Primary Weapon, Sidearm, Spec. Item, Armor, Helmet, Tac-Vest, Backpack (DT_GameplayTagToText_InventorySlots). An item is listed only when a vendor row exists for it.

primary = Inventory.Slot.Primary: 26 of the 29 also carry Inventory.Slot.Secondary (a second main weapon slot at runtime, not offered by the builder); the Compound Bow is Primary only. sidearm = Inventory.Slot.Sidearm (pistols and revolvers). special = Inventory.Slot.Specialist, the Spec. Item slot: the four launchers plus tools sold in the item shop (binoculars, range finders, hammers, wrench, drills, crowbar, fuel can, medical bag, defibrillator, remote detonators); those have kind tool, no class and no attachments.

kind: weapon, attachment, tool, armor, helmet, vest, backpack. class is the shop category (Weapon.Type.*) of weapons and can differ from archetype, the loadout archetype code (ID_WEPN_037 is shop class Assault Rifle, archetype DMR).
price: first shown vendor variation (else the first variation) from the weapon or item shop tables; priceHidden = no variation is shown in the shop. null price: no vendor row (most attachments).
weightKg: BHInventoryFragment_Weight on the item definition, null when the definition has none.

armor/helmet: armorClass is the Meta.Damage.Armor/Helmet context class; level Light=1, Medium=2, Heavy=3, SuperHeavy=4, null for Ghillie, Pilot, Tank. covers and durabilityReductionPct come from weapon-damage-locations.json meta.armor_items; durability is WDInventoryFragment_Armor.

backpack: grid [w,h] is the shop text ('Grid: 4x2'); the definition stores the same grid as X,Y = 2,4 (columns and rows swapped), so a single-grid pack without shop text uses [Y,X]; grids lists the raw X,Y of every grid container (side pockets and slings are extra grids); grid is null for a multi-grid bag with no shop text.
icon: assets/data/item-icons.json vendor png, else inventory png.
